items.title: youngyangyang04/llm-master
items.summary: 大模型（LLM）全栈学习路线与中文教程🔥：覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、AI Agent、MCP、微调、模型部署、Transformer、AI 编程与大厂面试，从入门到生产实践。
items.summary_zh: 一份覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、AI Agent、MCP 等全栈内容的中文 LLM 学习路线教程。
items.why_zh: 系统学习 LLM 全栈技术栈，从 Prompt Engineering 到模型部署，面试中可证明端到端项目能力。

items.title: Stop Overpaying for Intelligence | DevDay 2026
items.summary: Cut AI costs while preserving quality. Learn to measure cost per completed task, choose models and reasoning effort, and use prompt caching, Programmatic Tool Calling, and the Batch API.
items.summary_zh: 教如何降低 AI 成本而不损失质量，使用每任务成本度量、模型选择、提示缓存、工具调用和批量 API。
items.why_zh: 提供成本优化实战方法，帮助工程师在实际项目中平衡性能与费用。

items.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks
items.summary: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data. However, dense retrieval relies on surface-level semantic similarity, which is insufficient for increasingly complex search applications. Here, we investigate agentic retrieval that combines the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the efficient corpus exploration of retrievers in a ReAct agentic loop to solve complex retrieval tasks. In our expe
items.summary_zh: 提出结合LLM推理的agentic检索方法，以提升复杂任务的检索性能并分析成本。
items.why_zh: 体现检索增强生成与LLM推理结合的设计思路，可学习复杂任务下的检索策略与成本评估方法。

items.title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
items.summary: arXiv:2610.06923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable
items.summary_zh: 提出 RadOnc-Agent，利用 LLM 编排放射治疗全流程的 AI 工作流，实现跨阶段、跨模态的协同。
items.why_zh: 了解如何用 LLM 编排复杂多步骤医疗工作流，学习跨模态数据融合与任务分解的实践框架。

items.title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate
items.summary_zh: 提出比较价值估计方法为长 horizon 工具使用Agent提供步骤级奖励，改善信用分配。
items.why_zh: 教授如何设计步骤奖励函数，提升长序列决策的强化学习效果。

items.title: Add Web Search to Managed Deep Agents for free with One MCP Config
items.summary: Nathan Drezner, PM at LangChain, shows how to add web search to a managed deep agent. LangSmith includes built-in search powered by Parallel, so it takes one MCP connection with no extra authentication. He asks a research agent a question its internal docs can't fully answer, adds the search server, then deploys to LangSmith and inspects the search tool calls in LangSmith Studio. Chapters: 0:00 Why give your managed deep agent web search 0:21 Start from the docs 0:38 A research agent limited to …
items.summary_zh: 演示如何通过单个MCP配置免费为LangChain托管深度代理添加网页搜索工具，无需额外认证。
items.why_zh: 展示工具集成的标准化流程（MCP），可学习在代理中快速插入外部能力而不改动核心逻辑。

items.title: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
items.summary: arXiv:2610.06914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and
items.summary_zh: Text2Dashboard 将自然语言分析请求转换为可检查的企业仪表盘，含插件、运行时和审计机制。
items.why_zh: 演示受控 Agent 架构如何实现可审计、可恢复的数据分析，可学习在企业场景中构建可信任的 LLM 工具。

items.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
items.summary: arXiv:2610.10590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. items.summary_zh: 提出 Agent‑可控遗忘机制，用短注释替换工具结果并保存原始内容以便恢复。
items.why_zh: 展示如何在 Agent 中实现可逆的上下文压缩，提升长任务中的信息检索效率。

items.title: How to Build a Model Router in the Harness
items.summary: Sydney Runkle, product manager for LangChain's open source team, walks through how the team built a model router into Open SWE, LangChain's open source coding agent. She covers the four steps: mapping the task mix from LangSmith traces, picking models along the Pareto frontier, building the router in the harness, and tracking outcomes. In an A/B test against always using the performance model, the router cut median cost per thread by 64% with no measurable change in quality. Chapters: 0:00 Front…
items.summary_zh: 说明在Open SWE agent中构建模型路由器的四步：任务混合映射、Pareto前沿模型选择、harness集成及结果追踪。
items.why_zh: 展示如何基于任务特征选择模型并构建路由，可学习模型组合与性能成本权衡的实践。

items.title: What is an agent skill? How to protect your agent's context window.
items.summary: What’s the difference between a long-running agent that can seamlessly execute complex tasks, and one that constantly get stuck? The context. A bad agent is usually the outcome of high volume of information being crammed into a context window all at once. Skills are how LangChain's Deep Agents harness fixes that. A Skill is a folder with instructions, scripts, references, and assets for one task, but only its name and description load at startup. It’s like reading the back of a book instead of t…
items.summary_zh: 解释 Agent Skill 为文件夹形式的任务指令、脚本等，用以防止上下文窗口过载并提升复杂任务执行。
items.why_zh: 教授如何通过 Skill 机制管理上下文，提升 Agent 任务鲁棒性，是 LangChain 深度 Agent 的核心实践。

items.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
items.summary: arXiv:2610.10549v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distr
items.summary_zh: 通过可扩展的 Agent‑系统交互模拟生成符合企业 schema 的表格数据，用于训练工具调用 Agent。
items.why_zh: 提供可复用的数据合成方法，解决企业数据受限下的 Agent 训练与评估问题。

items.title: Three Questions Every Agent Engineer Should Be Able To Answer
items.summary: Jake Broekhuizen of LangChain Labs argues that owning your own intelligence comes down to three questions every agent engineer should be able to answer: where is your agent failing, how can you reliably make it fail again, and what needs to happen so it stops failing. He covers using a fine-tuned judge to mine production traces when frontier LLM-as-judge evaluators get expensive at scale, building world specs and tasks that mimic production with LangChain's internal GTM agent as the example, and…
items.summary_zh: 提出三个关键问题：代理失效位置、可靠复现方法及停止失效所需条件，并介绍微调判定法挖掘生产轨迹
items.why_zh: 提供定位与复现代理失效的系统化思路，可用于调试和提升代理鲁棒性
